title: vaccinium floccosum
intro: Vaccinium floccosum, commonly known as the woolly blueberry, is a species of shrub in the heath family. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its rich content of antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as potential cardiovascular and antioxidant support. The therapeutic actions of Vaccinium floccosum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and show potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents present in Vaccinium floccosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal and nutritional value.
